$comment: AC-AI-07.2 - the committed manifest of prompt versions that have run in
each named file and fails CI on any difference, with a message to create
Why a manifest and not a query. The check runs in CI, which has no
credential for a production database and should not have one. A committed
file is the only form of this fact that a pull request can be checked
against - and it makes 'this prompt is live' a reviewable line in a diff
rather than a state only the database knows.
An entry is added by the deploy that first uses the version, from the
`ai_usage` rows it wrote. Entries are never removed: a version that has
produced a stored artifact stays resolvable forever, because the artifact
Empty because no prompt has run anywhere yet - the features that own them
arrive in P1-P6. The check is live regardless, so the first entry is
protected from the moment it is written.
